title: Fleet version mix
description: Active clients per version, lease demand and outcomes, baked pool composition, and bare-metal slot capacity. Sources: the connector's http_request access records and the pool_gauge_sweep / host_lease_request metric records in modal_logs. Set minds_env only on the shared dev instance.

list.name: minds_env
list.label: minds_env (blank = all; set on the shared dev instance)

panels.title: Active accounts by client version (hourly)
panels.description: Distinct authenticated accounts per X-Imbue-Client identifier. The desktop polls sync endpoints about once a minute while open, so any hour a client ran is represented. '' = pre-0.4.1 / unversioned clients.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS x_axis_1, spath(body, 'imbue_client') AS breakdown_1, count(DISTINCT spath(body, 'user')) AS y_axis_1 FROM "modal_logs" WHERE spath(body, 'type') = 'http_request' AND coalesce(spath(body, 'user'), '') != '' AND ('$minds_env' = '' OR spath(body, 'minds_env') = '$minds_env') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Lease requests by client version and HTTP status (hourly)
panels.description: POST /hosts/lease and /hosts/claim from the access records: create demand per client version, with failures visible as non-2xx statuses.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS x_axis_1, concat(spath(body, 'imbue_client'), ' -> ', spath(body, 'status')) AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "modal_logs" WHERE spath(body, 'type') = 'http_request' AND spath(body, 'method') = 'POST' AND spath(body, 'path') IN ('/hosts/lease', '/hosts/claim') AND ('$minds_env' = '' OR spath(body, 'minds_env') = '$minds_env') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Lease outcomes by region and branch (hourly)
panels.description: host_lease_request metric records: leased vs pool_exhausted / no_host_keys / injection_failed, tagged with the requested region and template branch. pool_exhausted rising for one branch is the restock signal.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS x_axis_1, concat(spath(body, 'tags.outcome'), ' | ', spath(body, 'tags.region'), ' | ', spath(body, 'tags.branch')) AS breakdown_1, sum(CAST(spath(body, 'value') AS DOUBLE)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "modal_logs" WHERE spath(body, 'type') = 'metric' AND spath(body, 'name') = 'host_lease_request' AND ('$minds_env' = '' OR spath(body, 'minds_env') = '$minds_env') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Baked available hosts by branch and region
panels.description: pool_hosts_count gauge (status = available), emitted every 5 minutes by pool_gauge_sweep with explicit zeros, so a drained series drops to 0 instead of going stale.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minutes') AS x_axis_1, concat(spath(body, 'tags.branch'), ' @ ', spath(body, 'tags.region')) AS breakdown_1, max(CAST(spath(body, 'value') AS DOUBLE)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "modal_logs" WHERE spath(body, 'type') = 'metric' AND spath(body, 'name') = 'pool_hosts_count' AND spath(body, 'tags.status') = 'available' AND ('$minds_env' = '' OR spath(body, 'minds_env') = '$minds_env') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Leased workspaces by branch and region
panels.description: pool_hosts_count gauge (status = leased): the fleet-composition view -- how many live workspaces still sit on each template branch.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minutes') AS x_axis_1, concat(spath(body, 'tags.branch'), ' @ ', spath(body, 'tags.region')) AS breakdown_1, max(CAST(spath(body, 'value') AS DOUBLE)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "modal_logs" WHERE spath(body, 'type') = 'metric' AND spath(body, 'name') = 'pool_hosts_count' AND spath(body, 'tags.status') = 'leased' AND ('$minds_env' = '' OR spath(body, 'minds_env') = '$minds_env') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Bare-metal slot capacity by region
panels.description: pool_slots_total vs pool_slots_used per region (ready boxes; occupancy = placed pool rows). The gap between the two lines is the empty slots.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minutes') AS x_axis_1, concat(spath(body, 'name'), ' @ ', spath(body, 'tags.region')) AS breakdown_1, max(CAST(spath(body, 'value') AS DOUBLE)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "modal_logs" WHERE spath(body, 'type') = 'metric' AND spath(body, 'name') IN ('pool_slots_total', 'pool_slots_used') AND ('$minds_env' = '' OR spath(body, 'minds_env') = '$minds_env') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Pool gauge sweep heartbeat
panels.description: pool_gauge_sweep_ok records per 10 minutes (expected: 2). A gap here means the gauge panels above are stale, not that the pool is fine.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '10 minutes') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "modal_logs" WHERE spath(body, 'type') = 'metric' AND spath(body, 'name') = 'pool_gauge_sweep_ok' AND ('$minds_env' = '' OR spath(body, 'minds_env') = '$minds_env') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
